name: Fairfax County, Virginia (United States)
description: Light blue field with a yellow border, charged at the centre with the county seal: the arms of Lord Fairfax of Cameron in a ring reading COUNTY OF FAIRFAX VIRGINIA 1742.
history: Fairfax County is a county in Northern Virginia. The county's logo, seal and flag are derived from the arms of Thomas Fairfax, 6th Lord Fairfax of Cameron, the proprietor of the Northern Neck.

features.role: county seal with the arms of Lord Fairfax, reading COUNTY OF FAIRFAX VIRGINIA 1742
